note: The Korean caption each c2_video_audio_caption clip carried, TRANSCRIBED BY EYE from the burnt-in text of the delivered stimulus. It exists nowhere as data: no file under the corpus, the mask run or the upstream pipeline holds these strings, so they were read off the video frame at t=5s. Verify against the footage before running a study on them. Lines are separated by \n, as they appeared.
warning: These are NOT translations of tidy_data.csv's orig_text in every case. amsterdam_012 says 'the sound of a running train' where orig_text and the AudioSet labels are a police siren over traffic; singapore_040 says motorcycle where orig_text says car, wind and bird; amsterdam_057 and bangkok_034 also diverge. Which text is the study's prepared caption is a researcher's decision, not a staging one.
